name: Shipping Guard – Advanced Shipping Suite, Weight Based Shipping, Zero Emission & Protection
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Welcome to Shipping Guard, the most powerful and comprehensive logistics command center ever built for WooCommerce. Shipping Guard isn’t just a plugin; it’s a complete fulfillment strategy designed to protect your margins, automate your shipping calculations, and wow your customers with transparency.

Whether you’re looking for a robust Shipping Guard solution to handle internal insurance, or you need a sophisticated Shipping Guard weight engine, this suite has you covered.

🛡️ Shipping Guard Core Features (Free Forever)

The free version of Shipping Guard provides the essential foundation every store needs to stop losing money on logistics.

  • Advanced Weight Shipping Logic: Calculate rates based on actual product mass. Set base handling fees and incremental rates per unit (lbs, kg, oz, g).
  • Smart Weight Thresholds: Define a “Free Allowance” limit (e.g., first 5 lbs are free).
  • Excess Charge Logic: Choose between charging only for the “Extra Weight” beyond the threshold or “Full Weight” once the limit is crossed.
  • Shipping Guard Protection (Insurance): Offer customer-funded shipping insurance at checkout to cover lost, damaged, or stolen parcels.
  • Centralized Claims Dashboard: Manage protection claims with a professional interface. Approve or reject with one click.
  • Zero Emission Eco-Delivery: Position your brand as sustainable. Allow customers to pay a small carbon-offset fee.
  • Green Analytics: Track your total CO2 reduction directly in the Shipping Guard dashboard.
  • Estimated Delivery Dates (EDD): Display clear “Arrives by” dates to reduce support tickets and increase buyer confidence.
  • Product-Level Fixed Fees: Apply specific handling surcharges to fragile or oversized items directly in the product editor.
  • Free Shipping Overrides: Easily grant global free shipping if a specific “Hero Product” is in the cart.
  • Global Unit Synchronization: Shipping Guard automatically detects your WooCommerce Weight/Dimension units and updates all UI and math accordingly.

💎 Shipping Guard Pro – Enterprise Automation

Upgrade to Shipping Guard Pro to unlock our most advanced fulfillment algorithms designed for scaling businesses.

  • 3D Box Packing Inventory: Define your physical boxes (L X W X H). Shipping Guard Pro calculates the smallest box needed for every order to eliminate “shipping air.”
  • Volumetric (DIM) Math Logic: Automatically bill based on package volume when it’s greater than mass. Perfect for large, lightweight items.
  • Advanced Condition Engine (Table Rates): Create complex rules. Surcharge shipping based on User Roles (Wholesale vs Retail), Cart Subtotals, or Category weights.
  • Express Priority Lanes: Launch a premium “Skip the Line” service. Use our “Standard + Add-on” logic to ensure Express remains proportionally priced as standard rates scale.
  • Conversion Progress Bars: Show real-time snackbars and goal trackers to push customers toward free shipping thresholds and increase AOV.
  • Premium React Interface: Manage your entire logistics stack from our ultra-fast, modern “Logistics Command Center.”

🚀 Why Choose Shipping Guard?

Because every cent matters. Shipping Guard is built to capture the revenue that disappears into under-calculated shipping or lost package costs. By using Shipping Guard, you are installing a high-precision filter for your fulfillment process.

👉 Start your journey with Shipping Guard Pro today and master your delivery margins.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the shippingguard folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Shipping Guard menu in your sidebar.
  4. Activate the modules your store needs (Weight, Protection, Eco, etc.) and save.
sections.faq:
Does it support International units?

Yes! Shipping Guard is fully internationalized and syncs with your store’s native lbs, kg, cm, or inches instantly.

Can I customize the email alerts?

Yes, Shipping Guard includes an integrated email engine for claim updates and feedback notifications.
